Research and travel oriented grants that Shikhara is aware of. Almost surely non-exhaustive.
<ul>
<li> The <a href="https://eseb.org/prizes-funding/godfrey-hewitt-mobility-award/">Godfrey-Hewitt Mobility Award</a> from ESEB </li>
<li> The <a href='https://www.evolutionsociety.org/content/society-awards-and-prizes/graduate-research-excellence-grants.html'>R C Lewontin (early PhD) and Rosemary Grant (late PhD) awards</a> from SSE </li>
<li> The <a href='https://www.amnat.org/announcements/apply-student-research-award.html'>Student Research Award</a> from the ASN.</li>
<li> The <a href = 'https://www.biologists.com/grants/travelling-fellowships/'>Travelling Fellowships</a> from the Company of Biologists. </li>
<li> If you are a PhD student in our group, you have access to what Tom calls the Dead Lady Money (funding from the Sibylle Kalkhof-Rose Foundation). See details <a href='https://www.foerdern-und-stiften.uni-mainz.de/sibylle-kalkhof-rose-stiftung/'>here</a>. </li>
<li> If you are part of GenEvo, there is also some funding there for covering APCs etc. Contact the GenEvo overlords (Judith and Nele) for details. </li>
</ul>


:::
